normalize_primitive_weights: normalize primitive GTO basis function weights so contracted orbitals square integrate to 1
full_cart2sph: compute the transformation matrix from full cartesian derivatives to spherical harmonic representation for angular momentum l
cart2sph: convert cartesian coordinates to spherical coordinates returning rho, phi, and theta arrays
solid_harmonic: compute all solid harmonics r^ell Y_{ell,m} up to a given maximum angular momentum on a grid
Mol_eval_gto: evaluate all contracted Gaussian-type orbitals on a grid of xyz coordinates using JAX
